GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS

APO 500
2 May 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of Internees.
1. The following persons, incarcerated in Sugamo Prison on 7 March 1946, were released unconditionally 28 April 1945:
BABA, Masaharu
HONDA, Yutaka
KIKUCHI, Yoshio
HIRAYAMA, Katsutoshi
NAGATA, Yiroshi
SAKAKIBARA, Minoru
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will therefore make the proper notations in its records.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
